exposure: Patient safety culture (teamwork, psychological safety, communication)
outcome: Hospital nulliparous term singleton vertex cesarean rates
cohort: 3091 clinicians from 54 out of 57 eligible maternity care hospitals in Michigan participated in the survey.
finding: Vaginal birth microculture was the strongest predictor of cesarean delivery overuse, while safety culture characteristics (including teamwork, psychological safety, and communication) also correlated with lower cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal birth microculture was the strongest predictor of cesarean delivery overuse, and safety culture characteristics correlated with lower cesarean delivery rates.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via electronic survey, assessing current hospital culture and cesarean rates.
gest_age: Term (as implied by 'nulliparous term singleton vertex cesarean rates')
